kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
حببتما (form I)
# حَبَبْتُمَا (ḥababtumā) /ħa.bab.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of حَبَّ (ḥabba)
# حُبِبْتُمَا (ḥubibtumā) /ħu.bib.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of حَبَّ (ḥabba) and حُبَّ (ḥubba)
# حَبُبْتُمَا (ḥabubtumā) /ħa.bub.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of حَبَّ (ḥabba)
# حَبِبْتُمَا (ḥabibtumā) /ħa.bib.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of حَبَّ (ḥabba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
